notes.title: Multiple Instances loaded?
notes.content:
There are some reviews claiming this game loads multiple instances.
and was behaving weirdly. I was in fact using a plugin to enable the game
to run on background back in time when Construct 3 had not yet a Date behaviour.

Well turns out I am no longer using this plugin so there is literally nothing that may be causing this.

Reviews could perhaps be fake. Most of my fans havent reported this issue...

But maybe they are real* and are referring to this wierd plugin I was using that was causing the game to crash!

notes.title: OFFLINE PROGRESS(Fixed Crash Bug)
notes.content:
Game now runs even when [b]OFFLINE[/b] or when on [b]BACKGROUND[/b].

Hope you like these changes they have been requested alot!

Please if you find any bugs on new patch please report them....

notes.title: Adjusting XP reward!
notes.content:
I am trying to increase xp values from rings so that you can level up faster in previous model you would be stuck on level 25....

I recommend starting a new game if  somehow you leveled up too much...

If not keep playing the game!

Anyways the most important is that you have fun!

cheers!
